I'm sure the leaders of Ripoblus would be happy to pay in advance for Imperial weapons.''"<br />"''From what we've seen, they already have a supplier. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] served as a '''representative''' of the [[Dimok government]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the [[Sepan campaign]] of the [[Sepan Civil War]], he met with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was secretly selling Imperial weapons to both the Dimok and [[Ripoblus government]]s.<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" />
